characters.name: Rowan
characters.role: Keeper of the Starlight Tea Shop
characters.description: A young witch fresh from the Royal Arcane Academy, inheriting her late grandmother Amalia's cozy tea shop and her tattered grimoire.
characters.quote: The greatest magic sometimes is just a warm cup of herbal tea and a shared smile.
characters.schedule: All day: Managing the Starlight Tea Shop & herb gardens

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: A plump, intelligent little owl who brings mysterious botanical seeds back to your mailbox every morning.
characters.quote: Hoo... coo... *tilts head and blinks*
characters.schedule: Dawn: Delivers seeds to mailbox; Afternoon: Perches on porch

characters.name: Mallow
characters.description: A round calico cat who sheltered in the shop during a thunderstorm and never left; loves slumbering near warm lanterns.
characters.quote: Meow... *contented purrs*
characters.schedule: All day: Lounging warmly by the brick oven or timber counter

characters.name: Lumi
characters.description: Unique Kemomimi-Elf spirit featuring fluffy white fox ears atop jade twin-tails, pointed elven ears, and a soft crimson knitted scarf.
characters.quote: The howling forest winds tonight make my ears ring... could I have something cool and gentle to soothe my heart?
characters.schedule: Afternoon: Strolls through Whisperwood; Evening: Quiet corner at tea shop

characters.name: Boris Barnaby
characters.description: Stout, hardy dwarven smith with twin-braided russet beard and an ash-stained leather apron from years at the anvil.
characters.quote: Hammering steel all day leaves me bone-weary. The furnace is hot, but my heart feels cold... got anything sweet and fragrant with wild cinnamon?
characters.schedule: 07:00 - 18:00: At the forge anvil; 19:00: Cinnamon rolls at the tea shop

characters.name: Maeve
characters.description: Gentle elder herbalist with silver hair pinned in a low bun and a spring-embroidered kerchief; foster grandmother to Kael.
characters.quote: The caterpillars were harsh on my pumpkins today. Weeding since midday has my old back aching, little witch...
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 17:00: Selling seeds in Town Square; Evening: Strolling riverside

characters.name: Kael
characters.description: An orphaned boy with a pointed wool cap, patchworked winter coat, and bright curious eyes; Maeve's beloved ward.
characters.quote: Grandma Maeve's knees have been aching in the damp air... Can I trade my matchboxes for some ginger tea for her?
characters.schedule: Morning: Practice yard; Evening: Sipping cold berry tea

characters.name: Grandmother Amalia
characters.description: Rowan's late grandmother, legendary tea crafter whose warmth lives on through annotated grimoire margins and fond memory.
characters.quote: True magic isn't found afar; it lives in the care you pour into each tea leaf and warm morsel you bake for another.
characters.schedule: Present in grimoire margins, cherished memories, and dreams

characters.name: Bram
characters.description: Veteran miner prospecting the deepest mine levels; Boris's younger brother. Gruff and argumentative, but fiercely devoted to family.
characters.quote: My brother Boris is lecturing me about brittle iron ore again... Brew me something deeply bitter so I can swallow my temper!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 17:00: Mine shafts entrance; Evening: Arguing at Boris's forge

characters.name: Penny
characters.description: Energetic, nimble pastry seller; niece of Boris and Bram. Quick-witted, cheerful, and always inventing eccentric new baked goods.
characters.quote: Uncle Boris just tapped out a star-shaped cookie cutter for me! Let me try that tart berry tea to inspire my next batch!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 16:00: Postal run; 18:00: Dropping letters off at the tea shop

characters.name: Professor Orion
characters.description: Astronomer stationed atop the hill observatory; Clara's father. Absentminded and so captivated by constellations that he forgets meals.
characters.quote: The Cygnus constellation just shifted three degrees... My eyes are blurring, do you have a brew that lets my thoughts rest for two hours?
characters.schedule: Night: Stargazing at Observatory; Morning: Napping in library

characters.name: Clara
characters.description: Meticulous curator of Oakhaven's archives; Orion's daughter. Organized, caring, and constantly reminding her father to take care of himself.
characters.quote: Father stayed up in the observatory tower for two days without food again... Could you brew a big pot of chamomile tea so I can make him drink it?
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 17:00: Library and dispensary; Evening: Calming lavender tea

characters.name: Captain Garrick
characters.description: Weathered sea captain who has hung up his oars; Finn's grandfather. Delights in recounting tales of uncharted celestial islands.
characters.quote: The valley wind smells of the great outer seas of my youth... Give an old sailor a robust spiced cup and listen to my stories of the floating isles.
characters.schedule: Sunday Morning: Anchoring his nautilus vessel by the pier market

characters.name: Finn
characters.description: Spirited boy who fishes along mountain streams and misty lakes; Garrick's grandson. Fascinated by luminous aquatic fauna.
characters.quote: I hooked a huge rainbow-glowing trout today! Grandpa Garrick said I could bring it by the tea shop for a frosty peppermint refresher!
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 18:00: Angling by the starlight brook; Evening: Warming by hearth

characters.name: Elora
characters.description: Graceful seamstress tailoring moonlight velvet robes; Sylvan's kindred spirit. Her fingers ache from days of meticulous silver needlework.
characters.quote: My fingertips sting from stitching gala robes with silver needles all day... Is there a jasmine blend that eases weary hands?
characters.schedule: All day: Tending Sylva-Fae canopy silk greenhouse

characters.name: Sylvan
characters.description: Monocled botanical researcher from the elven woods; Elora's confidant. Frequently trades ancient roots for grounding, hearty teas.
characters.quote: Poisonous mist hangs dense over the woods tonight... I brought you millennium roots, would you trade a warming earthy brew for them?
characters.schedule: Afternoon & Evening: Patrolling Sylva-Fae ancient boughs

characters.name: Marlo
characters.description: Steadfast town guard keeping watch through long, freezing snowy nights while Oakhaven slumbers peacefully.
characters.quote: Wind howls right through the gaps in my armor... On long night patrols, only your spicy tea keeps my eyes from snapping shut.
characters.schedule: 07:00 - 17:00: Operating Oakhaven windmill grinding flour

characters.name: Aurelia
characters.description: Caring town healer running the dispensary clinic. Believes wholesome teas heal spirits far deeper than bitter salves alone.
characters.quote: Potions only close surface wounds... Townspeople need your warm herbal teas to soothe their deeper quiet sorrows.
characters.schedule: Morning: Honeybee apiary; Afternoon: Delivering fresh honey to shop

characters.name: Valen
characters.description: A refined vegetarian vampire aristocrat; terrified of garlic but utterly enchanted by ruby-red sweet berry infusions. Visits only after dusk.
characters.quote: The aroma of garlic bread from your shop drifted all the way to my parapet and made me faint... Please, a goblet of crimson sweet tea to restore my poise!
characters.schedule: Patrolling the marble plaza of Solaria Capital of Light

characters.name: Kassandra
characters.description: Nomadic comet sorceress drifting through cloud currents; her enchanted broomstick frequently runs low on mana mid-flight.
characters.quote: My broomstick is running low on arcane ether mid-cloud... Do you have a tea infused with canopy night dew to replenish my spells?
characters.schedule: Managing merchant expeditions in Solaria Capital

characters.name: Chrono
characters.description: Clockwork relic remaining from a lost civilization; speaks with a rhythmic tick-tock cadence and needs periodic chamomile oil lubrication.
characters.quote: Tick-tock... Left chest gear mechanism grinding... Requesting 200ml warm floral lubricant with chamomile essence... Tick-tock...
characters.schedule: Tending the perpetual clockwork waterwheels in Khaz-Drakor

characters.name: Lapis
characters.description: A buoyant mermaid journeying onto dry land for the first time, delightfully captivated by warm pastries that dissolve on the tongue.
characters.quote: Down in the deep ocean, everything is perpetually soggy... Tasting hot, crispy pastries that melt away like sweet foam is sheer wonder!
characters.schedule: Prospecting deep crystal caverns in the Khaz-Drakor mines
